step1.title: Pick some favorite photos to get started
step1.desc1: Drag or click the upload area. JPG / PNG / HEIC are all supported.

step2.title: Make layout super easy
step2.desc1: ① Click "✨ One-Click Album" to enter selection mode
step2.desc2: ② Check the photos you like

step3.title: Not happy with the layout? Tweak it
step3.desc1: Try "Fine-tune" — the XY sliders default to 0; drag in different directions to change the photo density distribution.
step3.desc2: "Transform" can rotate the page 90° or randomly swap to another layout; if you don't like it, "Restore Layout" anytime to start over.

step4.title: Flip, sort, do as you please
step4.desc1: The thumbnail bar at the bottom holds all page-management actions — drag to reorder, add or remove pages, zoom preview, and grid view gives you the full picture.

step5.title: Make every photo shine
step5.desc1: Double-click any photo on the canvas to edit — crop composition, adjust color temperature and brightness, apply filters; make it look however you like.

step6.title: All set, ready to share
step6.desc1: Click "Export" in the top-right corner and pick your format: print to PDF as a keepsake, or save as image to share with friends.

step1.title: Home Navigation
step1.desc1: On the left you can switch between "Albums" and "Layouts", manage existing albums or start from a layout.

step2.title: Create your first album
step2.desc1: Click "Create Album" to pick a size, fill in a name, and enter the editor to start creating. When you have no albums yet, you can also click "Start Creating" in the middle.

step3.title: Backup & Restore
step3.desc1: The top-right corner offers data import/export. We recommend regularly exporting all data as a zip backup; on a new device, use "Restore from backup file" to import.
